studies.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art weapon/tool art-direction reference sheet for the game 星壤物语 / STARSOIL. Input image 1 is a reference inventory atlas; image 2 is the actual game scene and HUD, reference only. Create a new refined cohesive sheet, do not reproduce a screenshot. A carefully aligned 4 by 4 grid of sixteen large isolated sprite studies on deep ink-navy background, subtle copper thin dividers and ample negative space. First row: wooden, copper, iron, cyan crystal pickaxes. Second row: wooden, copper, iron, cyan crystal swords. Third row: wooden axe, iron axe, hunter bow, star staff. Fourth row: bundle of arrows, luminous crystal charm, cloud boots, star core orb. All are original cozy exploration sandbox designs with strong readable silhouettes, short warm brown grips, restrained bronze gold fittings, teal crystal facets and one-pixel highlight accents. Show the same clear 3/4 diagonal inventory pose and consistent pixel density in every cell. Detailed but practical for subsequent manual reduction to 16 to 24 pixel inventory icons; sturdy tool heads, logical grips, distinguish tier by material and shape. Authentic crisp hand-placed pixel clusters with limited palettes, integer-scale presentation, clean stepped contours; avoid glossy 3D rendering, blurred edges, excessive glow or filigree. Small top title 'STARSOIL / EQUIPMENT STUDIES', optional tiny English tier labels only, no long paragraphs. The sheet should feel like polished production concept art for the existing game, not a ready-to-import sprite atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two-section original pixel-art inventory and interface icon reference board for 星壤物语 / STARSOIL. Input image 1 is the existing item atlas and image 2 is the real game HUD, references for palette and visual language only. Create a new premium coherent art-direction board on deep navy, thin warm bronze framing, warm ivory headings. Top half heading 'INVENTORY': twelve neatly spaced isolated sprite studies in a 6 by 2 grid: red mushroom, red healing potion, teal mana potion, violet recall potion, wood log bundle, stone block, coal chunk, copper ore, iron ore, luminous cyan crystal cluster, copper ingot, iron ingot. Bottom half heading 'INTERFACE': twelve much simpler highly readable icons in a 6 by 2 grid: backpack, crafting hammer with anvil, armor equipment chestplate, open guidebook, quest star marker, red health heart, teal mana droplet, map pin, home cabin, pause menu, interaction speech bubble, settings cog. Every interface icon must read at 16 pixels, use 2 to 4 main color clusters, consistent line weight and copper/ivory/teal palette, with no decorative noise. Inventory items can use a few more pixel clusters but must retain an immediately distinct silhouette. Include tiny native-size examples beside the enlarged studies so reduction intent is clear. Genuine crisp square pixel construction, sharp stepped outlines, calm shadows, controlled highlights. Original art only. No photo texture, no vector rounded app icon style, no blur, no smooth 3D, no in-game screenshot simulation, no text beyond these short English headings.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original pixel-art logo and app-emblem concept for the existing game 星壤物语 / STARSOIL. Input image 1 is the current grass-and-crystal app icon and image 2 is the actual navy/copper game interface, visual references only. Make a refined new transparent-background logo reference sheet with three clean separated deliverables: a large primary horizontal title logo centered in the top two thirds, a standalone square-composition emblem below left, and a very simple miniature emblem below right. Primary title text must be exactly '星壤物语' with the smaller secondary text exactly 'STARSOIL'. Four Chinese characters, carefully readable custom square pixel lettering, warm ivory faces with modest bronze-gold stepped extrusion and deep navy contour; do not distort or substitute glyphs. Build an original small emblem of a warm earth cross-section with tiny green grass top, two cool teal crystal facets and one bright gold four-point star, integrated subtly with the title. Standalone emblem should have the same readable crystal, earth and star silhouette and remain meaningful at 32 pixels, with the miniature using only a few pixel clusters. Keep the organic pixel-adventure feeling of the existing icon while removing visual clutter and oversize glow. Crisp native pixel edges, consistent limited palette, disciplined geometry, balanced spacing and hierarchy. A design reference concept, not a storefront screenshot or a game screen. Transparent background with real alpha, no fake checkerboard, no enclosing rounded square, no extra labels or presentation text. Avoid franchise imitation, smooth vector curves, glossy 3D bevels, blurry lighting or ornate unreadable lettering.
